type.description: Type of the call to action (e.g. nested, web_url, postback)

title.description: Title text of the call to action

payload.description: Payload data for postback type actions

call_to_actions.description: Array of nested call to action items

webview_height_ratio.description: Height ratio of the webview when opened

messenger_extensions.description: Whether Messenger extensions are enabled for the webview

fallback_url.description: Fallback URL for clients that do not support Messenger extensions

webview_share_button.description: Whether the share button is shown in the webview
